notes: The microphone button next to the composer now works. It went to Cursor's backend, which this build has no entitlement for, so it could never have worked here; dictation is now served through your OpenRouter key. Pick a model first in Settings -> Router under Transcription model: nothing is chosen by default, so dictation stays off until you choose one. Spoken replies are not included, because Grok Bot has no text-to-speech to match.
